title: 100k-Row Engine: Main-Thread Sort vs Worker Actor + Wasm + OPFS
description: Compare blocking 100k-row sorts and JSON IndexedDB writes on the main thread against an off-main-thread Worker actor with zero-copy transfers and OPFS sync writes.

before.label: Main-Thread Sort + JSON Persistence
before.previewNote: Every sort triggers a >600 ms Long Task, starving rAF, dropping frame rate to 4 FPS, and allocating 90 MB of transient JSON strings.

after.label: Worker Actor + Wasm Sort + OPFS Sync + Transfer
after.previewNote: Main thread stays at 60 FPS; only a zero-copy ArrayBuffer of sorted row indices crosses the Worker boundary.
